description: Extreme close-up on MAKER'S eyes reflecting matte-black desk lamp stuttering; slow push-in to hands hovering then pressing flat against workbench wood. Lamp strobe syncs to pulse beneath grain. Cool blue shadows contrast with warm amber key light pool from lamp. Shallow depth of field prioritizes eyes, fingers, and light interaction over wide exposition. Camera: Static tight frame eye-level on eyes (SC_001_B01), slow push-in on hands and lamp base (SC_001_B02), cut to medium close-up tilting down following hand sliding flat against wood (SC_001_B03). Hard cuts within beat sequence; pacing 2-4-3 seconds builds tension. Match cut intent at end on light pulse. Lighting: High-contrast practical lighting. Cool blue shadows dominate background; warm amber key light pools from matte-black lamp on subject's face and hands. Light transitions from stuttering flicker to steady sync as hand makes contact with surface. Constraints: MAKER wears charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows, faint grease smudge on left knuckle. Props: matte-black desk lamp (flickering dot-dash pattern), blueprint paper. Audio cue: Sharp electrical click, half-second dead silence before dialogue 'You just answered.' tight/wireless mic; wood scrape foley merges with rhythmic mechanical thrum as hand contacts surface

Lamp glow stabilizes from flicker to warm steady light. Shallow depth of field focuses on hand/prototype interaction and light transition. Camera: Low angle tracking shot sliding under desk lip to reveal prototype (SC_002_B04), hard cut match from SC_001 light pulse.
